name: Ribbonfield
alt: Red and orange filaments sweep into an asymmetric twist, with a broad fan and a shorter open return.
description: Fine filaments compress into a diagonal twist and spread back into open fans. The tension between narrow and wide sections creates the motion.
assessment: The most fluid direction. The small version needs fewer filaments and a cleaner crossing.

name: Foldscape
alt: Angular vermilion, orange and oxblood planes fold around an offset spine with white clefts.
description: Broad planes fold around an offset spine. Sharp edges, stepped proportions and white clefts create a compact, architectural composition.
assessment: The strongest solid masses. The joins and pointed outer edges need precise vector refinement.

name: Phasefield
alt: A field of red, orange and oxblood ellipses bends into a broad crest and smaller returning lobe.
description: Separate particles bend through a changing field. Their size, spacing and orientation create an apparent wave without any connecting lines.
assessment: The most different construction. Tiny particles need reducing so the flow survives at small sizes.
